name: jotter
title: Jotter
description: A teacher’s CV site made as a school exercise book: an orange cover with a printed Name and Subject label, and feint-ruled white pages with a red margin line where each role’s dates sit, printing on one sheet of A4.

tokens.--font-print: printed typeface (Gill-style sans): cover title, menu, label words, employers and places, small capital headings
tokens.--font-text: written typeface (serif): page text, titles, CV entries, the name on the label
tokens.--text-xs: smallest text: label words, the Skills heading, the label link to the CV
tokens.--text-s: small text: margin periods, employers and places, menu, contact lines, footer
tokens.--text-l: CV entry titles, a page opening line, the cover title
tokens.--text-xl: headings inside a page, the name on the label
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the name at the top of the CV
tokens.--line: the ruling: gap between feint lines, and the line height of all text written on them
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of large titles and cover text
tokens.--color-bg: the white page every text is written on, and the label paper
tokens.--color-text: black ink: text, headings and their underlines, the label frame
tokens.--color-muted: lighter ink: employers and places, label lines, list dashes, quote bars
tokens.--color-accent: marking red: link underlines and links under the pointer
tokens.--color-margin: the red margin line down every page
tokens.--color-feint: the feint-blue ruled lines, and table row lines
tokens.--color-cover: the cover around every page (orange by day, slate at night)
tokens.--color-cover-ink: ink on the cover: site title, menu, print note, footer
tokens.--color-cover-shade: shadow under pages and the label, the page edges beneath, print button hover
tokens.--color-spine: shading in the fold of the open book on the home page
tokens.--color-staple: the wire of the two staples in that fold
tokens.--page-width: widest the cover and the open book get
tokens.--margin-width: margin left of the red line, where periods are written
tokens.--label-key: width of the label words Name, Subject, Contact
tokens.--space-3: normal gap, the space after the margin line, the side margin on a phone
tokens.--space-4: roomy gap: cover and label padding
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: the space right of the text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the print button, code, images and focus rings
